english.title: Camping 101: Blacksmithing
english.detail:
So, you've become a Blacksmith. That's a great choice if you want to make sure your blades never dull.

I reckon I know someone that can help with that by teaching you how to craft a Sharpening Wheel. Bring one of these out at your camp and all the warriors and rogues in the area will be lining up to hone their weapons.
english.objective: Speak with Smith Argus in Goldshire to learn to craft a camping item for your profession once you have shown proficiency in your skill.
english.progress: Yes, I can teach you.
english.complete:
There you have it, you can now craft your very own Sharpening Wheel. Most folk don't care much for camps being set up in the center of town, so you'll need to head into the wilderness if you want to test it out.

Oh, and just remember, no camp is complete without a campfire. You'll need one of those before you start up your camp. Most cooks can teach you to make a fire. If you haven't already, you might want to check in with someone who can train you in the culinary arts to learn the basics.

upstreamVariants.title: Кемпінг 101: Ковальська справа
upstreamVariants.detail:
Отже, ви стали ковалем. Це чудовий вибір, якщо ви хочете бути впевнені, що ваші клинки ніколи не затупляться.

Гадаю, я знаю когось, хто може допомогти вам у цьому, навчивши вас, як виготовити точильне колесо. Принесіть одне з них у свій табір, і всі воїни та розбійники в окрузі вишикуються в чергу, щоб відточити свою зброю.
upstreamVariants.objective: Поговоріть зі Смітом Аргусом у Голдширі, щоб навчитися створювати предмети для кемпінгу для вашої професії, як тільки ви продемонструєте майстерність у своїй навичці.
upstreamVariants.complete:
Ось і все, тепер ти можеш виготовити точильний круг для власного табору. Людям зазвичай не подобається, коли табір розбивають посеред міста, тож випробувати його доведеться на природі.

І ще пам'ятай, жоден табір не обійдеться без багаття. Перш ніж облаштовувати табір, тобі потрібно його розпалити. Більшість кухарів можуть цього навчити. Якщо ще не вмієш, звернися до наставника з куховарства й опануй основи.

upstreamVariants.detail:
Гірничодобувна справа — не найгламурніше, але це гарна чесна робота та чудова професія, яку варто досліджувати.

Гадаю, я знаю когось, хто може навчити тебе виготовляти магніт для твого табору. Збудуй один з них, і кожен, хто хоче розмахувати мечем, захоче зібратися навколо твого вогнища та насолодитися його додатковою «силою», щоб підвищити свою бойову майстерність.
upstreamVariants.objective: Поговоріть з Кранном у Рейзор-Гілл, щоб навчитися створювати предмет для кемпінгу для вашої професії, як тільки ви продемонструєте майстерність у своїй навичці.
upstreamVariants.progress: Я можу навчити тебе вдосконалювати свої вміння.
upstreamVariants.complete:
Ось і все, тепер ти можеш виготовити магнітяк для власного табору. Людям зазвичай не подобається, коли табір розбивають посеред міста, тож випробувати його доведеться на природі.

І ще пам'ятай, жоден табір не обійдеться без багаття. Перш ніж облаштовувати табір, тобі потрібно його розпалити. Більшість кухарів можуть цього навчити. Якщо ще не вмієш, звернися до наставника з куховарства й опануй основи.

english.title: Camping 101: Skinning
english.detail:
Being able to skillfully harvest the skins and hides of fallen beasts is one of the more valuable skills an adventurer can possess.

I reckon I know someone that can teach you how to craft a Camp Chair for your camp. Sometimes it's important to just take a load off, and you can use some of those hides you've gathered to make a comfy chair to sit in. A bit of relaxation can help ensure that you are at your peak condition and can strike where it counts the next time you find yourself in a dust-up.
english.objective: Speak with Thuwd in Orgrimmar to learn to craft a camping item for your profession once you have shown proficiency in your skill.
english.complete:
There you have it, you can now craft your very own Camp Chair. Most folk don't care much for camps being set up in the center of town, so you'll need to head into the wilderness if you want to test it out.

Oh, and just remember, no camp is complete without a campfire. You'll need one of those before you start up your camp. Most cooks can teach you to make a fire. If you haven't already, you might want to check in with someone who can train you in the culinary arts to learn the basics.

upstreamVariants.detail:
Вміння вміло збирати шкури та шкури полеглих звірів – одна з найцінніших навичок, якими може володіти шукач пригод.

Трохи відпочинку може допомогти вам бути у найкращій формі та вдарити там, де це потрібно, наступного разу, коли ви опинитеся в запиленій хаосі.

english.title: Grund and Gozwin
english.detail:
Oi, had me back turned gettin' the boar roast ready when I heard me pal Gozwin screamin' fer his life!

Wicked fangs and a blur are all I saw when I turned. Such huge paws! A snow leopard was draggin' its gnomish catch away. I grabbed me shotgun and fired above the beast. It dropped him and sprinted off.

Luckily, it hadn't done more than give ol' Goz some deep scratches.

Head back to camp in the northwestern hills and retrieve Gozwin's Mechanic's Log. Kill that snow leopard too if you see it!
english.objective: Find Grund and Gozwin's camp in the hills to the northwest. Recover Gozwin's Mechanic's Log and kill the Snow Leopard Prowler.
english.progress: Poor Goz is more concerned for his mecha-walker than himself. Says if anyone gets a hold of that mechanic's log he's greased. Hah! That's why I told him he should just leave his work at home!
english.complete:
Aye, I'm not surprised to hear that snow leopard was makin' a meal of the boar we were fixin' fer roastin'!

Goz will have one less thing to stress about now that you brought back his log book. Maybe now he can focus all his energy on gettin' back on his feet.

Thanks, <name>. Take a little something as a token of my appreciation, fer makin' the trek, and fer protectin' the hills.

english.title: Beer Basted Boar Ribs
english.detail:
Nothing my tavern patrons enjoy more than some Beer Basted Boar Ribs!  Only problem is, the local trapper who used to bring me supplies enlisted in the King's Army to help with the war on the Alliance front. 

Maybe you can help me out?  If you bring me six crag boar ribs and a Rhapsody Malt from the tavern here, I'll give you the family recipe for my famous Beer Basted Boar Ribs, not to mention a free sample!  The secret's in the Malt!

english.complete:
The Malt is brewed, the Boars are dead
And before all is done and anything said
We will have to fight for first dibs
On these savory Beer Basted Boar Ribs!

english.title: Supplying the Front
english.detail:
The mountaineers of Loch Modan are fighting troggs, and having a busy time of it!  They need constant supplies of new armor and weapons if we're ever to get a handle on those troggs.

That's why my colleague Thorvald is there, trying to keep the mountaineers in good gear.  So if you were to make some copper axes and copper chain belts and bring them to Thorvald, he would be obliged.  He might even share his knowledge with you.

Thorvald is in Loch Modan's southern guard tower.
english.objective: Bring 6 Copper Axes and 6 Copper Chain Belts to Thorvald in the southern guard tower of Loch Modan
english.progress: I have no time to chat.  Do you have business with me?
english.complete:
Ah, apologies!  I didn't realize you were here to help resupply our troops.  The stuff you made will be a big help!

Here are plans for some armor.  I hope you find them useful.

english.title: Gearing Redridge
english.detail:
We dwarves aren't the only ones fighting.  Our human allies have their hands full too!

Redridge is under periodic attack from blackrock orcs, and their supply of equipment is always low.  If you were to help them out, I'm sure their resident blacksmith, Verner Osgood, would teach you a trick or two.
english.objective: Tormus Deepforge  wants you to bring 4 Runed Copper Belts and 4 Heavy Copper Mauls to Verner Osgood in Redridge.
english.progress: I hope you're here with good news from Ironforge.  Because I'm at my wit's end!
english.complete:
Thank you, <name>.  This will help me out tremendously.  With the Blackrock orcs attacking from Stonewatch Keep and the Redridge gnolls lurking in the foothills to the north, I'm always fixing armor and making new weapons for our troops.

The supplies you brought will give me a moment's peace.  I will have enough time to teach you something...

english.title: Deeprun Rat Roundup
english.detail:
Avast ye scallywag. Arrrr... Arrrr ye looking fer work? We gots a serious rat problem down here an' not enough hands on the poop deck.

What do ye say? All ye needs to do is take this here rat catchin' flute and play the melody around the vermin. They'll follow ye to the ends of the world!

Just capture five of the little buggers and bring em back here. We needs em alive.

Arrrrr...
english.objective: Capture 5 Deeprun Rats by using the Rat Catcher's Flute. Lead the rats back to Monty. Don't forget to turn in the flute when you're finished.
english.progress: Yarrr... Swabby, what be takin' ye so long?
english.complete: These'll werk nicely, matey. Me brother needs em still tickin' and kickin,' else they go sour... Ye don't want to taste no sour rat kabob.

english.title: Me Brother, Nipsy
english.detail:
Me brother, Nipsy, runs a rat kabob operation on the other side of Deeprun. Ye needs to take this here crate o' rats to him before they go bad. Get a move on!

Ye have ridden a tram before, aye? It's easy. Just step aboard when she arrives and enjoy the ride. An' keep yer arms and legs inside durin' the ride, lest ye be peglegged fer life.
english.objective: Take the Carton of Mystery Meat to Nipsy at the Stormwind Deeprun Tram Depot.
english.progress:
<Nipsy puts his index finger through one of the air holes in the carton.>

Alive and kicking... and just in time!
english.complete:
Poor Monty. Ever since the Gnomeregan incident, he hasn't been the same. That boy has never seen an ocean in his life, let alone being some kind of pirate.

<Nipsy sighs.>

At least he keeps the flow of twitching critters coming.

Er, uh... I mean... thank you for bringing all of this to me. Here's a little something for your trouble.

english.title: Easy Strider Living
english.detail:
Do you smell that delicious aroma? It's my secret recipe, <name>--fresh strider stew. Delicious!

Perhaps you would be interested in learning the recipe?

Before I teach you the recipe, you will need to prove that you can handle the beasts.

Now, I don't expect you to go out and tame one and ride it back to me, but if you can kill a few and bring back some of their succulent meat, I may be persuaded to show you the ways of strider stew.
english.objective: Bring back 5 Strider Meat to Alanndarian Nightsong in Auberdine.
english.progress: The pot is empty and I'm hungry! What's taking you so long?
english.complete: Fantastic! Try it and tell me what you think, <name>!

english.title: Recipe of the Kaldorei
english.detail:
Long ago, the night elves were called the kaldorei, a name that means "children of the stars." Learning of the past is an important step in your path as a <class>, <name>, so listen well to what I have to tell you.

The kaldorei have always taken much pride in their harmonious relationship with nature. This means that we only take from nature what is necessary, and that we return in kind. This balance has afforded us much, <name>.

Go out and collect seven small spider legs -- no more than that, and return to me.
english.objective: Collect 7 Small Spider Legs for Zarrin in Dolanaar.
english.progress: Remember the balance, <name>. I wish you to develop an understanding and a strong empathy for the living forests.
english.complete: Always remember what I have shown you today, <name>. You are part of the balance that the night elves strive to keep intact, even during troublesome times.

english.title: Elixirs for the Bladeleafs
english.detail:
Our herb and alchemy shop is booming, but my husband spends so much time mixing potions that we never have time for each other.

Can you help us?

If you can bring me a supply of pre-made elixirs, then I would be happy to trade with you.  I have some rare herbs that you might find useful.
english.objective: Bring 6 Elixirs of Lion's Strength and 2 Elixirs of Minor Defense to Syral Bladeleaf in Dolanaar.
english.progress: Hello, <name>.  Do you have the elixirs to trade?
english.complete:
These are nicely mixed.  You take great care in your trade, <name>, and that is important for an alchemist.

Here are your herbs, freshly gathered.  May you use them well.

english.title: Moonglow Vest
english.detail:
We in Darnassus, especially we craftsman, are quite busy.  Young adventurers are eager to test themselves in the wilderness, and are in constant need of supplies.

If you can help me fill my orders of leather goods, then perhaps I can teach you an advanced leatherworking technique.
english.objective: Bring 1 Embossed Leather Glove, 5 Embossed Leather Boots and 5 Embossed Leather Cloaks to Lotherias in Darnassus.
english.progress: Greetings, <name>.
english.complete:
Yes, these are good pieces. You have a skilled hand and an eye for detail. Your future as a leatherworker is promising.

Here, <name>. Let me show you the pattern to make the Moonglow Vest.

english.title: Gaffer Jacks
english.detail:
I came to Auberdine because of the quiet.  I want to invent my inventions where it's quiet, because after a night of drinking I don't like all the noise of Ironforge!

So I took a ship to Auberdine and had a little too much to drink on the way.  I dropped my box of gaffer jacks overboard!  I need my gaffer jacks!

I don't know exactly where I dropped them, but if you fish for them in the ocean you might get lucky...
english.objective: Bring 8 Gaffer Jacks to Wizbang Cranktoggle in Auberdine.
english.progress: Did you find my gaffer jacks, <name>?  Without my gaffer jacks I can't tune my stintle pegs!
english.complete: I can't believe you found them!  You must be the luckiest <race> in Kalimdor!

english.title: Electropellers
english.detail:
We know you're lucky, but... just how lucky are you, <name>?

One night I was wandering the roads of Darkshore.  I was looking for a good river or lake to try my new self-propelled, exploding duck decoy and I think I was a little tipsy... because I passed out and awoke hours later in Auberdine.  My hair was singed and my bag of electropellers was gone!  I must have dropped them in the water!

I need those electropellers!  Maybe you can fish them out of some lake or stream in Darkshore...
english.objective: Bring 12 Electropellers to Wizbang Cranktoggle in Auberdine.
english.progress: Did you find any electropellers?  I'll need them if I'm to continue my research on duck decoys...
english.complete:
I can't believe it!  You found them!  You are the best fisherman I've ever seen!

Thank you, <name>.  And here, take these.  Although you're so good and you probably don't need them, they will help you with your fishing.

english.title: Fishin' Time
english.detail:
What a view... Best an old man can ask for.

The fish sure are bitin' now, though I'm down to my last bait. I don't suppose you have any spare fishing supplies on you? Of course not, forgive me. I get so excited at the thought of casting another line it didn't dawn on me I may be one of the few carrying supplies everywhere I go.

Would you be able to help refresh my stock? Catherine Leland has an assortment of fishing goods just west of the Trade District along the canals. Tell her old Gray sent you.
english.objective: Bring 1 Shiny Bauble and 3 Nightcrawlers to Gilbert Gray at the harbor in Stormwind.
english.progress: Did you get the fishing supplies?
english.complete:
Great timing! Caught a big one with my last bait. Great day so far. They're really biting out here!

Tell you what, since you were kind enough to keep this old man in business how about a few fish for the road?

english.title: Expanding Horizons
english.detail:
Auberdine is a humble place, <class>. You won't hear its name spoken in the boughs of Darnassus. Most reference only what the Sundering took from us--the thriving cities of Ameth'Aran, Bashal'Aran, and... Lathar'Lazal.

Yet Auberdine remains in their shadow.

I would see our work here recognized. A new vessel connects us to the kingdom of Stormwind, bringing life and supplies to our shores. I beseech you to join its next voyage, and bring this letter to a human called Baros Alexston.

Make our home known.
english.objective:
Bring Thundris' Letter to Baros Alexston in Stormwind.

Thundris mentioned a boat in Auberdine that can take you there.
english.progress:
I can smell the sea on you, friend!

<Baros laughs.>

What brings you to Stormwind?
english.complete: <Baros opens the letter and begins to read it, his smile fading.>

english.title: Speaking of Fortitude
english.detail:
I'm giving a speech on the Fortitude of the Spirit, and I'd like to recite passages from a particular book on metallurgy - "The Stresses of Iron."  A copy of this book should be in the Royal Library, within Stormwind Keep.  Can you retrieve it for me?  If so, then may the blessings of the Light be with you!

The Royal Library is very large, but the head librarian, Milton Sheaf, knows each shelf like it was his own son.  Speak to him, he'll retrieve the book for you.
english.objective: Go to the Royal Library in Stormwind Keep and speak with Milton Sheaf.  He can find for you the book on metallurgy that Brother Kristoff needs for his speech.
english.complete: Metallurgy?  Ah yes, we have many books on the subject, and are happy to aid Brother Kristoff with his speech!  Now...which particular book was it the good brother needed?

english.title: Brother Paxton
english.detail:
The Stresses of Iron?  Yes, I know the book.  Quite a good one, written by the Dwarven miner Margulf Blaggon a few decades ago.  He spent most his time deep in the mountains of Khaz Modan, digging ore.  Smart fellow!

But where was I?  Oh yes, the Stresses of Iron!  I'm afraid the book was moved to the Northshire Abbey.  The caretaker of the Abbey's library, Brother Paxton, wanted to make a copy of the book for his own shelves.

But that was months ago.  I wonder why it's taking him so long...
english.objective: Speak with Brother Paxton in the Northshire Abbey.
english.complete: Mr. Sheaf is wondering where his book is?  Well this is a tad embarrassing.  I have the book, but I'm still making my copy and I'm not quite ready to give the original up!

english.title: Ink Supplies
english.detail:
I've been meaning to finish my copy of The Stresses of Iron, but...

Well you see, I make my own ink for books I copy.  It's my own recipe; it doesn't run or smear, and it dries very quickly  Unfortunately, it dries too quickly!  My last batch dried up before I could finish the copying job, and I haven't had the chance to make more ink!

To make more I need Rethban Iron Ore from the Redridge Mountains.  Foreman Oslow in Lakeshire is my usual supplier.

english.title: Rethban Ore
english.detail:
Rethban Ore is named after the man who first found it, Bart Rethban.  When smelted it's not as strong as iron, but its ore has a dark, flat color that some scribes use in their dyes.  It can be found in the Rethban Caverns, north of here.

We usually have some in stock, but we're too busy preparing for Orc attacks to gather any.  And besides...Redridge Gnolls are now living in the Rethban Caverns and their Drudgers are gathering the ore themselves.

So if you need some, you'll have to get it yourself.
english.objective: Gather 5 loads of Rethban Ore and bring it to Brother Paxton in the Northshire Library.

Thank you, <name>!

Rethban Ore is named after the man who first found it, Bart Rethban.  When smelted it's not as strong as iron, but its ore has a dark, flat color that some scribes use in their dyes.  It can be found in the Rethban Caverns, north of here.

We usually have some in stock, but we're too busy preparing for Orc attacks to gather any.  And besides...Redridge Gnolls are now living in the Rethban Caverns and their Drudgers are gathering the ore themselves.

So if you need some, you'll have to get it yourself.
english.progress: Do you have the Rethban Ore?
english.complete:
Oh, splendid! I can use this ore to make my dye, and then can finish copying The Stresses of Iron.

Thank you, <name>!

english.title: Zinge's Delivery
english.detail:
The wolf hearts you acquired possess a quality unseen in similar specimens.  There is a toxicity to them that should be deadly to the very wolves in which the hearts beat!

It's quite incredible, and we must study it further.  I kept a few samples of the hearts acquired.  Take them to my colleague, Apothecary Zinge.  You will find her in our headquarters in the Undercity.
english.objective: Bring the Wolf Heart Samples to Apothecary Zinge in the Undercity.
english.progress: You have something for me?
english.complete: Ah yes, the heart samples of which Renferrel spoke.  I am eager to experiment with these... it is always of interest to the Royal Apothecary Society when new forms of toxins are discovered.

english.title: Sample for Helbrim
english.detail:
A colleague in Kalimdor, Apothecary Helbrim, is researching the effects of Lordaeron toxins on the beasts of Kalimdor.  He would be very interested in a sample of the wolf hearts Renferrel sent me.

Helbrim is stationed in the Barrens, in a village known as the Crossroads.  To reach him, you must travel via zeppelin to the orc capital of Orgrimmar, then travel south, by foot, to Durotar.  Head west into the Barrens, and you will soon reach the Crossroads.
english.objective: Bring the Wolf Heart Sample to Apothecary Helbrim in the Barrens.
english.progress: You have a package for me?
english.complete:
Ah, very good.  If initial reports are true, then the toxicity of these hearts could lead to further advances in our knowledge of poisons.

This is a welcome delivery, <name>.  Your reward is well earned.

english.title: Prompt Potion Runner
english.detail:
You! Quickly, I need you to bring this potion across the slime canal to Doctor Martin Felben in the Apothecarium!

It has a very limited shelf life, and no I can't go myself, my knees rattle and pop out if I attempt to run.

Just another lovely side effect of undeath, apparently.

But we're wasting time! Here, take this and go!

<Alessandro makes a shooing motion.>
english.objective: Bring the Unstable Potion to Doctor Martin Felben in the Apothecarium within the time limit.
english.complete:
Ah, marvelous! I had been waiting for Alessandro's potion to arrive. The last six he sent destabilized along the way, but you've made it just in time!

Here, take this for your effort. That is all for now, unless you have other business with me?

If not, remove yourself so I may continue my experiments unhindered.

english.title: The Weaver
english.detail:
An archmage of great power is overseeing the reactivation of the ley energy node. With the progress they have made, our only hope of stopping them is by killing him. It will be difficult, he is no doubt protected by many other mages and warders.

You must go, and you must dispatch him quickly. When he is dead, retrieve his staff for me. Go now.
english.objective: Kill the Dalaran archmage, then retrieve his staff for Shadow Priest Allister at the Sepulcher.
english.progress: Quickly, time runs short, <name>!
english.complete:
The magic of the wizards dissipates, and the ley energies fade into dormancy. Your efforts have been fruitful, <name>, and we have dealt a major blow to our enemies, and to the overbearing wizards of Dalaran.

We must be vigilant, however, knowing that source of energy lies so close at hand... Plans must be made for the future.

english.title: Beren's Peril
english.detail:
I have received reports that a group of undead are holing up to prepare for an attack against us. Armed with this information, we can turn the tables and attack them first, nipping their little plan in the bud.

Unfortunately, my information is spotty, at best. They are reported to be hiding in a location known as Beren's Peril. The exact location is unknown, but it appears to be a cave in the hills, near a pocket of Dalaran wizards.

I trust your resourcefulness. Find them, and put them down.
english.objective: Locate Beren's Peril, then kill 6 Ravenclaw Drudgers and 6 Ravenclaw Guardians, then return to Shadow Priest Allister at the Sepulcher.
english.progress: Have you located their base yet, <name>? Time is of the essence!
english.complete: If our scouts and agents continue to procure valuable information such as this, we shall have the Lich King's Scourge removed from our lands in no time.

english.detail:
Now is the time to assault the Scourge's place of strength in Silverpine: Fenris Isle.

You must again go to the Isle and destroy Thule Ravenclaw.  I want his head!

This mission is as dangerous as it is vital, <name>.  You must not fail.
english.objective: Bring Thule's Head to High Executor Hadrec at the Sepulcher.
english.progress: The Scourge cannot be allowed to remain in Silverpine, <name>.  Come back to me when you have proof of Thule's death.
english.complete:
The death of Thule Ravenclaw was no small event, <name>.  Renferrel tells me that the energies released when you destroyed Thule were felt even as far as the Sepulcher.

Your actions ring through the ranks of the Forsaken.  Your value to us grows.

english.title: Hamuul Runetotem
english.detail:
The shells you brought me have a taint, one I have never before seen.  I am certain the water of the Oases is the cause, and I can sense the confusion they cause this land.  It is as if the land dreams and cannot awake.

The Wailing Caverns must be the source of the taint.  But before you go there, speak with Hamuul Runetotem, the elder druid.  I sent word to him of the happenings in the Barrens.  He is wise, and can offer you counsel.

You will find him in Thunder Bluff, on the Elder Rise.
english.objective: Speak with Hamuul Runetotem
english.complete: I bid you greetings, <name>.  You are welcome here, and I suggest you gather all your strength.  For the task we now set before you ... is a dire one.

english.title: Nara Wildmane
english.detail:
I entered the land of dreams, and dreamed of a cult of druids who dwell in the Wailing Caverns.  I saw that their goals were once noble, but they have lost their way.  They are now servants of the taint seeping through the Barrens.

I am old and my strength fails.  I could not long dwell in that dreaming place and know little more of the tainted druids.  But Nara is young and her spirit is fierce.  She remained in the dreaming when I fled.

Speak with Nara.  She is in the tent, over yonder.
english.objective: Speak with Nara Wildmane.
english.complete:
Yes, it is true.  I know of the druids in the Wailing Caverns.  I have seen their twisted, scaled faces.  I know their crimes, and I know their plans.

You must stop them, <name>.

english.title: Leaders of the Fang
english.detail:
The druids in the Wailing Caverns, the Druids of the Fang, are an aberration.  They were part of an order of noble druids whose plan was to heal the Barrens, but now seek to remake that land to match their own, twisted dreams.

The Druids of the Fang have four leaders, and each possesses a dream gem.  Even now their faces haunt me!  Defeat the leaders and bring me their gems, and the Barrens may again know peace.

Go, <name>.  You will find them lurking deep within the Wailing Caverns.
english.objective: Bring the Gems of Cobrahn, Anacondra, Pythas and Serpentis to Nara Wildmane in Thunder Bluff.
english.progress: Memories of my nightmares haunt me, <name>.  Have you defeated the leaders of the fang and acquired their gems?
english.complete:
You have done it, <name>.  You killed the leaders of the Druids of the Fang.  My dreams are now free of their wicked faces, and you have helped save the Barrens from a cursed future.

english.objective: Bring the Gems of Cobrahn, Anacondra, Pythas and Serpentis to Nara Wildmane in Thunder Bluff.
english.detail:
The druids in the Wailing Caverns, the Druids of the Fang, are an aberration.  They were part of an order of noble druids whose plan was to heal the Barrens, but now seek to remake that land to match their own, twisted dreams.

The Druids of the Fang have four leaders, and each possesses a dream gem.  Even now their faces haunt me!  Defeat the leaders and bring me their gems, and the Barrens may again know peace.

Go, <Name>.  You will find them lurking deep within the Wailing Caverns.

english.title: Trouble at the Docks
english.detail:
Oops!

Had a little mishap, as you can see! The morning cargo shipment from Booty Bay was huge. Huge I say! Never seen so many crates. Well, I was trying to expedite things so I started unloading a bit more than I could handle. That's when everything came tumbling down.

Before I knew what was going on, I saw that menace, Mad Magglish, go running off with a bottle of 99-year-old port. Chased him all the way to Wailing Caverns. No way I was going in there.

Maybe you're brave enough to find him?
english.objective: Crane Operator Bigglefuzz in Ratchet wants you to retrieve the bottle of 99-Year-Old Port from Mad Magglish who is hiding in the Wailing Caverns.
english.progress:
The dockmaster has been on my case ever since Mad Magglish made off with that 99-year-old port. I guess that bottle was intended as a gift for Gazlowe from none other than Baron Revilgaz himself.

If you're brave enough and patient enough to seek out Mad Magglish and get that port back, I'll see to it you get a nice reward.
english.complete:
Superb! And just as I was about to lose my job too! I will see to it that Gazlowe gets this gift immediately.

Thank you, <name>. Nicely done, I say!

english.title: Serpentbloom
english.detail:
The Royal Apothecary Society, based in the great Undercity of Lordaeron, has sent me here for a very specific service, <name>. Perhaps you wish to aid me, and in turn The Dark Lady in our efforts to advance the Forsaken.

Recently I studied a rare specimen of flora named Serpentbloom. I believe in greater quantities this herb has great potential.

Unfortunately Serpentbloom can only be found in the darkest recesses of the Wailing Caverns, a dangerous cave system located in the Barrens.

english.title: Deviate Hides
english.detail:
As Naralex descended deeper into his nightmare, a strange breed of beasts arose from beneath the Barrens into the Wailing Caverns.

These deviate creatures have strange, otherworldly properties. While evil in nature, it is my opinion that some good can come from their existence here in Kalimdor. I believe their hides will be of particular use in the ways of leatherworking.

If you feel up to the task, venture into the caves below and retrieve some deviate hides.
english.objective: Nalpak in the Wailing Caverns wants 20 Deviate Hides.
english.progress: I am very interested in examining the hides from the deviate creatures who have infested these caves. Have you had any luck in collecting some, <class>?
english.complete:
Your efforts shall not go unnoticed in gathering these hides, <name>.

Thank you for your dedication.

english.title: Deviate Eradication
english.detail:
Naralex had a noble goal.

Our great leader aspired to enter the Emerald Dream and help regrow these harsh lands back into the lush forest it once was. But something went terribly wrong.

Naralex's dream turned into a nightmare and corrupt creatures began to inhabit the caverns.

While some Disciples of Naralex seek to awake our master, my concern is with ridding these caves of the evil beasts.

Brave the caverns, <name>, and eradicate the deviate spawn.
english.objective: Ebru in the Wailing Caverns wants you to kill 7 Deviate Ravagers, 7 Deviate Vipers, 7 Deviate Shamblers and 7 Deviate Dreadfangs.
english.progress:
<name>, we, the Disciples of Naralex, need your help. Our numbers are dwindling with our master trapped in his twisted nightmare. We have not the forces necessary to deal with the corrupt creatures which now haunt these caverns.

I beg of you, enter the caves and wage war on the deviate creatures!
english.complete:
As a Disciple of Naralex, I commend your bravery, <name>.

Your aid in ridding the caverns is the first step in our long plight to see the Barrens restored.

Thank you and may you prosper.

english.title: Smart Drinks
english.detail:
Ok, so the raptor horns didn't work so well.  But that's all right -- no one got rich on their first try!  And besides, I think I found something that'll work even better in my smart drinks!

There is a substance called Wailing Essence, and I think it is the cause of the strange plants and animals in the Barrens.  Get me some and I'll try it in my drink!

I heard the essence gathers in ectoplasmic creatures in the Wailing Caverns to the west.  Hunt those creatures and gather the essence.
english.objective: Bring 6 portions of Wailing Essence to Mebok Mizzyrix in Ratchet.
english.progress: Where is my wailing essence?
english.complete:
Great, you got it!  I can't wait to try it out.  This is going to make me a fortune, I just know it!

Thank you, <name>.  Take this, and after I'm rich I'll send you more, I promise!

english.title: Root Samples
english.detail:
The herbs of the Barrens are not quite like herbs in other lands.  Their properties are mostly the same, but the oasis water here alters the plants; they are just slightly different.

I want to study those differences... to see if they're exploitable!

If you are skilled in herbalism, then gather root samples off the herbs you find in the Barrens.  Bring back these samples so that I may compare them with herbs from other regions.
english.objective: Bring 8 Root Samples to Mebok Mizzyrix in Ratchet.
english.progress: Hello, <name>.  Did you get those root samples?
english.complete:
Yes yes, these are very nice!  I will grow specimens from these roots and study them.  I hope to find new properties from them.  Hidden, valuable properties...!

And don't worry -- if I do then you'll be the first to know.  Because I'll need someone to gather more!
